title: A Quiet Minute Before the Car Door
caption:
The morning went sideways. School is still ahead, and so is the rest of the day.

Before the car, one slow breath out, loud enough for them to hear.
Then: "Fresh start, right here."
A hard morning doesn't need a fix. It needs a reset.

Save this for the mornings that need one.

#schoolmornings #morningroutine #elementarymom #parentingtips #steadydays
